snippet.title: Beast and Cleaver // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568030/Beast_and_Cleaver/

Beast and Cleaver is an open-world adventure where players hunt and fight rare creatures. Master attack patterns, learn unique monster spawning mechanics, and expand the Hanging City to unlock new potions and customizations. Prepare for the hunt - filled with secrets, strategy, glory, and more!

Developed by 
Grimes Productions
